targets.statement: Some collisions plus any traffic-violation conviction from an Oklahoma court or out-of-state court are placed on your driving record, which Service Oklahoma maintains in full and transfers if you seek a license in another state.

targets.old_statement: Pointable offenses score restriction violations two, reckless driving four, careless driving two, speeding two, twenty-five-plus-over three, school-bus stop failures four, tailgating two, sign or signal disobedience two, yield failures two, left-of-center or wrong-way two, defective equipment one, and all other violations one.

targets.statement: Pointable convictions assess four points for reckless driving or failing to stop or stay stopped for a loading or unloading school bus, three points for exceeding the posted speed limit by more than twenty-five miles per hour, two points for restriction violations, careless driving, speeding, following too closely, disobeying a stop sign or traffic signal, failing to yield, or driving left of center or the wrong way on a one-way road, and one point for a defective vehicle or any other violation excluding offenses requiring suspension or revocation.
